owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

ACC_PRECISION().notice: Precision for accRewardPerSet (reward per staked set, x1e18).

DAILY_RELEASE_BPS().notice: 10% of the remaining pool is released per day.

MAX_ACCRUAL_DAYS().notice: Reward accrual is capped at 365 days per update call, so a long gap between interactions cannot make one call loop forever.

accRewardPerSet().notice: Cumulative BNB reward per staked set, scaled by 1e18.

claim().notice: Claim pending rewards without unstaking. Claiming 0 pays 0 (no revert) — a second claim right after the first simply pays 0.

claimable(address).notice: Settled but unclaimed BNB (wei) for a wallet.

fundPool().notice: Fund the reward pool with BNB. Anyone may fund — the owner is expected to fund it from mint proceeds. Funds added here start releasing from the NEXT day (today's release was already computed from the old pool). There is no owner withdraw of the pool.

hasStake(address).notice: True while a wallet has a set staked in this contract.

lastUpdate().notice: Timestamp of the last reward update.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.notice: Required so safeTransferFrom into this contract works.

pendingReward(address).notice: Pending reward (wei) for a wallet: settled claimable plus rewards accrued since the last settle, simulating the daily 10% releases up to now. Does not change state.

poolBalance().notice: Pool BNB not yet released to stakers.

rewardDebt(address).notice: accRewardPerSet at the wallet's last settle, scaled by 1e18.

stake(uint256[5]).notice: Stake one complete set: tokenIds[0] must be Pointer, tokenIds[1] Ember, tokenIds[2] Verdant, tokenIds[3] Frost, tokenIds[4] Void — each owned by the caller. The 5 NFTs move into this contract (caller must approve first). One set per wallet.

stakedBy(address).notice: Token ids staked by a wallet ([0,0,0,0,0] when not staked).

unstake().notice: Unstake: returns all 5 NFTs to the staker and pays out all pending rewards in the same call. After this the wallet can stake a set again.
